brief: First apartment after graduation. I still sleep on a mattress on the floor and the moving boxes are everywhere. Make it feel like a calm, grown-up bedroom without painting.

render.prompt:
Image 1 is a real phone photo of a room to edit. Image 2 is a placement guide: the same photo with numbered translucent boxes showing where each product goes; use it only for position and scale and never draw its boxes or numbers. Images 3 to 5 are the reference photos of products 1 to 3, in order.
1. Replace the floor mattress with gray sheet with product 1: Pine Platform Bed Frame (bed), real size 136.9 x 190.6 x 35.6 cm (width x depth x height). Place centered against right wall where mattress now sits, long side to wall, head at back window wall. It belongs inside box 1 of the placement guide. Copy product 1 exactly from its reference photo: Low rectangular pine platform bed frame in medium brown with light wood slats and four straight legs. Same shape, proportions, color, material, texture, pattern and details, scaled to its real size relative to the room.
2. Replace the rumpled gray duvet with product 2: Ivory Diamond Matelasse Coverlet (bedding), real size 173 x 218 x 3 cm (width x depth x height). Dress mattress on new frame with duvet folded neatly, pillows at window end. It belongs inside box 2 of the placement guide. Copy product 2 exactly from its reference photo: Ivory diamond matelasse coverlet and shams draped on bed, ruffled edges, geometric stitched diamond texture, soft wrinkled cotton. Same shape, proportions, color, material, texture, pattern and details, scaled to its real size relative to the room.
3. Add product 3: Cream geometric criss-cross rug (rug), real size 182.9 x 121.9 x 1.3 cm (width x depth x height). Lay on wood floor in center walkway between bed and wardrobe, long edge parallel to bed, clear of desk chair. It belongs inside box 3 of the placement guide. Copy product 3 exactly from its reference photo: Rectangular low-pile area rug in cream with subtle raised criss-cross geometric weave and soft woven wool texture. Same shape, proportions, color, material, texture, pattern and details, scaled to its real size relative to the room.
Remove: cardboard moving box bottom; cardboard moving box middle; cardboard moving box small. Show the floor and wall that were behind them, continuing the surrounding texture, so it looks like they were never there.
Hard rules: keep the exact same camera position, framing, lens distortion and perspective. Keep the walls, wallpaper, floor, ceiling, ceiling light, windows, blinds or curtains, doors and every object that is not listed exactly as they are. Keep the existing light direction, color temperature and exposure; new products receive the same light and cast soft, physically plausible contact shadows. The result must look like an unedited phone photo of the same room, not a render. Do not add anything else: no extra decor, no text, no numbers, no colored boxes or outlines.
